reason: The native PostgreSQL wire client returns an array column as its text literal (for example "{1,2,3,4,5,6,7}") instead of a list; the bridge (psycopg) decodes it to [1,2,3,4,5,6,7].
ARRAY_AGG over a text column comes back from the native PostgreSQL wire client as the array literal string "{London,Paris,Berlin,London}" instead of a list; psycopg decodes it on the bridge.
